properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 10 at 1:23AM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 123 AM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms extending from 6 miles north of Karval to 13 miles east
of Wild Horse Point, or extending from 33 miles south of Limon to 53
miles southeast of Limon, moving east at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Mainly rural areas of Southeastern Lincoln County.
